reason: The 200% text and open-menu probes launched Playwright's bundled Chromium directly, which the ordinary guards job never installs, so both failed on CI with browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist (introduced by 20faa7803bee1678bf75084046c46caffd2e8535, #2269). detect fires on that direct launch in the probe and stays quiet once the probe uses launchBrowser, which falls back to the system Chrome the way apps/web's browser tests do.
